paper.title: Using a discrete global grid system for a scalable, interoperable, and reproducible system of land-use mapping

claims.vector: DGGS provides orders of magnitude performance improvement
claims.raster: DGGS and raster methods show roughly equivalent performance

vector_benchmark.conclusion: DGGS is orders of magnitude faster than vector overlay
